label: Individual text/author/source/term/object/local problem
definition: The item addresses a single text, author, source, term, object, or narrowly local problem.
inclusion: A single manuscript reading; one scholar's biography; a single term's etymology.

label: Explicit tradition, school, genre, or durable historical line
definition: The item explicitly frames a tradition, school, genre, large class, or durable historical line.
inclusion: Comparing texts within one school; genre-level surveys.
exclusion: A single-object study with no tradition framing (see G1).
examples: survey of a grammatical school's commentaries

label: Broad interregional, civilizational, comparative, or methodological synthesis
definition: The item synthesizes across regions, civilizations, or methodologies.
inclusion: Comparative civilizational arguments; explicit cross-tradition method papers.

label: Not applicable
definition: The item does not advance an identifiable scholarly frame at all.
inclusion: Announcements; bare resource links; greetings; bibliography-only requests.
exclusion: Any item making a scholarly claim at any level.

label: Unknown
definition: The item may be applicable but evidence is insufficient to assign a level.
exclusion: Any record where a level could be determined.
